\leader{241G}{}\cmmnt{ Now we have the following important properties
of $L^0$.

\medskip

\noindent}{\bf Theorem} Let $(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ be a measure space.   Set
$L^0=L^0(\mu)$.

(a) $L^0$ is Archimedean and Dedekind $\sigma$-complete.

(b) If $(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ is
semi-finite, then $L^0$ is Dedekind complete iff $(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ is
localizable.
target_text:
\leader{241G}{}\cmmnt{ Kini kita mempunyai sifat-sifat penting $L^0$
berikut.

\medskip

\noindent}{\bf Teorema} Misalkan $(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ suatu ruang ukur.
Tetapkan $L^0=L^0(\mu)$.

(a) $L^0$ bersifat Archimedes dan lengkap-$\sigma$ Dedekind.

(b) Jika $(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ semihingga, maka $L^0$ lengkap Dedekind jika dan hanya jika
$(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ dapat dilokalkan.
